headlines.label: Overtakes
headlines.detail: On track after lap 1 · most: SAI (10)

summary: Lando Norris won the Hungarian Grand Prix from P3 on the grid, 0.7s ahead of Oscar Piastri, with George Russell completing the podium.
Kimi Antonelli made the biggest climb, from P15 to P10.
Franco Colapinto had a day to forget, dropping from P14 to P18.
The stewards penalised HUL (5 second time penalty), GAS (10 second time penalty) and LEC (5 second time penalty).
There were 29 pit stops in total; the winner stopped once.
Oscar Piastri leads the championship by 9 points over Lando Norris.
